The Greeks believed their most important gods lived on Mount Olympus. Each {{< vocab "myth" zh=true >}} told stories about them.

:::: {layout-ncol=2}
::: {.callout-note title="Zeus 宙斯" icon=false}
**King of the gods.** In charge of the sky and thunder.\
**Symbol:** a thunderbolt ⚡
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Hera 赫拉" icon=false}
**Queen of the gods**, Zeus's wife. Goddess of marriage and family.\
**Symbol:** a peacock 🦚
:::
::::

:::: {layout-ncol=2}
::: {.callout-note title="Poseidon 波塞冬" icon=false}
**God of the sea**, storms and earthquakes. Zeus's brother.\
**Symbol:** a trident (three-pointed spear) 🔱
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Athena 雅典娜" icon=false}
**Goddess of wisdom** and protector of Athens. The Parthenon was her {{< vocab "temple" zh=true >}}.\
**Symbol:** an owl 🦉
:::
::::

:::: {layout-ncol=2}
::: {.callout-note title="Apollo 阿波罗" icon=false}
**God of music**, poetry, light and healing.\
**Symbol:** a lyre (small harp) 🎵
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Artemis 阿耳忒弥斯" icon=false}
**Goddess of hunting**, the wild and the moon. Apollo's twin sister.\
**Symbol:** a bow and arrow 🏹
:::
::::

## Design your own card

Pick a god or goddess from the list on Mount Olympus, or invent one. Draw them with their symbol, and write what they're in charge of.

{{< drawing-box label="My god or goddess" height="3.2in" >}}

**Name:** ______________________ **In charge of:** ______________________________
